I'd like all satellite dots in mini previews across all episodes to be the same size in pixels, regardless of the zoom. I want that size to be the same size as the satellite dots in the "Space Objects" column. 

I'd also like all satellite tails to be the same thickness across all episodes.

comments.text: I notice that the color-retreated background behind the mini preview does not go edge to edge. For all mini previews, the background color should extend all the way to top (i.e. so that it touches the bottom of the highlighted row above that describes this episode's key details), all the way to the right (i.e. so that it leaves no margin before the right edge of the table), and all the way down (all the way to the bottom edge of the expanded row).

comments.label: E-001 · context block

comments.label: E-001 · visual block
comments.text:
For all episodes in the table, when you hover over the mini preview, you should see a number of indicators that suggest that something happens when you click on the mini preview: 
1) The globe's coloring fades to a darker warmer color;
2) The satellites pulse and get a little bigger; and
3) The "Explore the interactive model" does its microinteraction dance (orbit undraws and redraws; rightward arrow nudge bounces to the right).
